reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getMonthActionCategories selector and reuses getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and the mutator/undoable registration.

duplication.why: Repeats the loop skeleton the other month-wide actions share (income/tracking skip, sign flip for expenses, setBudget) instead of sharing it, though no rule logic is copied.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts with the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts next to them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Simple and consistent with its siblings, so easy to own; the repeated per-category loop is the only drag.
